documents.title: פרק ששי: The קדושה of צדיקים and the חשיבות of Learning תורה
documents.oneLiner: Learning the sixth perek of Pirkei Avos, the Rav explains the kedushah of tzaddikim, whose very names carry holiness, and the greatness of one who learns Torah lishmah, for whom the whole world exists and whom the Torah guards from sin.

documents.title: The Special Holiness of נח תיבת: a Microcosm of the עולם התיקון
documents.oneLiner: The Rav explains that Noach's Teivah was a holy island of the perfected world, where even the lion ate grass, until Cham's sin brought back the curse, and that Hashem still remembered Noach with love because Avraham and the Jewish people would come from him.

documents.title: “ולאדם לא מצא עזר כנגדו” - זה קוב"ה וכנסת ישראל
documents.oneLiner: Starting from the Mishnah's sign of rain in the sukkah, the Rav explains that the yearly path from Rosh Hashanah to Shemini Atzeres repeats the creation of Chava, the bond of Hashem and Knesses Yisrael, and that a broken Sukkos can be rebuilt from Bereishis.

documents.title: הקדמה; ביאור קושיא הראשונה שבספר; ביאור כחו של שבועה.
דיבורים המעוררים את הלב
documents.oneLiner: For Elul, the Rav teaches that releasing others as in shmitah brings Hashem's release of our debts, and warns that letzanus, the scoffing that undoes emunah, shut Pharaoh off from reality and shuts a person out of tefillah.

documents.title: ג - ט"ו תמוז יארצייט האוה"ח הק' - תורה על הפרשה.
זמן לשאוב יראת שמים בעד הכנה לר"ה' זמן של שידוכים' ז' ימים אחר היו"ט הגדול של ט' באב לעתיד.
documents.oneLiner: The Rav explains Chamishah Asar b'Av as the start of the season of yiras shamayim and teshuvah leading to Yom Kippur, a day of shidduchim between Hashem and Klal Yisrael, and the yom tov of the hidden good in the churban: that the avodah of Jews in galus is more precious to Hashem than ever, which is why one adds in Torah from that day.
